description: Send one signed test request to a database webhook and report the outcome synchronously. Each call sends one request to the receiver unless it repeats an idempotency_key already used for this request, which returns the stored outcome; the platform allows one test per webhook every five seconds. If the answer is lost, call again with the same idempotency_key; without a key a second call sends another request.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.

name: database_webhook_test
